scope: Ten-page HelpCat training pilot only; not the final 100-project evaluation corpus.
independence_statement: Source-only audit of final adjudicated packets. Auditor previously performed the distinct blind agent annotations and used that manually constructed source inventory for completeness cross-checks. This audit is not human gold or an independently sampled statistical accuracy evaluation.
method: Read raw intake captures and final adjudicated packet fields; inspect exact declaration-token boundaries, literals/spans, transformation/provenance rules, default/choices fidelity, advertised entries, positional declarations and all canonical-line labels. Run allowed canonicalize/validate_pass/audit_catalog helpers only; no parser/tagger/model code or predictions used. No model-comparison results included.

source_checks: All 29 printed option declaration rows and their explicitly grouped aliases are represented; SRC appears only in usage and is not added as a positional.
Bracketed pipe-separated alternatives retain literal metavar and choices text, with arity/takes_value null. INTEGER RANGE is retained literally without inferring semantic type/range.

Explicit literal defaults 88, --safe, and the include regex retain direct source spans. The wrapped exclude regex is retained in description and its semantic default remains null rather than reconstructing a value.
Description spans preserve printed hyphenation and exact literals; normalized values collapse all whitespace, including doubled spaces.
All seven advertised command rows and two option rows are represented.
serve* is retained as the exact advertised name without stripping its marker or inferring default-command semantics.
Printed trailing ellipses remain literal truncated descriptions; no missing text is reconstructed.
All 11 option rows and 16 command rows are represented; explicit slash-separated flags are grouped.
The five TEXT declarations have required value arity. Other arity and takes_value fields remain null.
ASCII art is other, environment annotations continue descriptions, and wrapped auto- detection remains printed rather than being dehyphenated. Descriptive defaults remain unknown.
All 51 option declaration rows and three actual positional declarations METHOD, URL, REQUEST_ITEM are represented.
Short aliases select their separately printed declaration tokens, including -j, -f, -s, -p, -h, -m, -b, -v, -o, -d, -c, -q, -a, and -A; none selects an interior suffix of a long flag.
Auth preserves USER[:PASS] | TOKEN as a required value notation; optional password syntax is not confused with optional option arity.
Examples, lists, URLs and later paragraphs belonging to argument/option descriptions retain description_continuation labels and nonempty evidence spans; blank lines are excluded from evidence.
Literal defaults and explicit choices retain exact source text. Conditional pretty/print defaults remain unknown; generic --no-OPTION prose is not expanded into invented declarations.
All 16 option rows and 15 advertised command rows are represented. Slash-separated site-packages names are explicitly grouped.
Wrapped command and option descriptions are retained. Example invocations are other, their explanatory text is prose, and whitespace-only line 15 is blank.
Only the two TEXT option declarations establish required arity; no usage placeholders are added as positionals.
All five option rows and 20 individually advertised command rows are represented, including wrapped descriptions.
-q and -v evidence selects the separate printed short aliases rather than suffixes of --quiet or --verbose.
Environment-variable listings remain prose, and repeated brace grammar is other rather than an extra positional or command.
All 43 boxed option declaration rows are represented; space-aligned short and long names on the same row are grouped explicitly.
Evidence uses Unicode code-point columns in the original bordered text; descriptions exclude border/padding and retain the printed truncated URL.
Box header is section_heading, bottom border is other, and all continuation rows are description_continuation. Usage-only input alternatives are not inferred as positional declarations.
Both option rows and all eight advertised command rows are represented.
Examples heading is section_heading; code-block directive and shell examples are other, with no additional commands inferred.
Usage COMMAND and ARGS are grammar placeholders rather than separately advertised positionals; valueless-looking flags retain unknown arity.
All 15 option rows and 19 explicitly advertised command spellings are represented; parenthesized command aliases have their own exact name spans and shared source descriptions.
Brace choices and literal printed defaults retain direct evidence. REQ_JSON brackets establish optional value arity; semantic type and required presence remain unknown.
Startup/trailing config diagnostics and repeated brace grammar are other; descriptive group headings do not create command hierarchy.
All 31 option declaration rows and the actual dest positional declaration are represented; option-group headings do not create subcommands.
All printed aliases, brace choices, and literal defaults have direct source evidence; metavar evidence selects value tokens rather than substrings within option names.
The activators description starts at the actual prose text on line 59, column 32, excluding the option token and metavar.
Extra-search-dir preserves d [d ...] as required value notation; missing-config diagnostic is other.

summary.conclusion: No remaining source/evidence omissions detected in the ten final adjudicated pilot packets under the documented conservative annotation decisions. This is an agent source audit, not a human-gold or statistical accuracy claim.
